summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes, to fund school facilities.

schools.text: Measure C would provide locally controlled funding exclusively for Barstow Community College District facilities.
schools.quote: By law, all funds from Measure C must stay local, dedicated to BCCD only.

tax.text: A No vote would reject $37 million in bonds financed by annual taxes on property within the district.
tax.quote: A "no" vote means that the District will not be authorized to issue and sell the up to $37,000,000 in bonds set forth in the Measure.
